relevance_note: Single-pedigree report of Danon disease with a LAMP2 splice variant ('Analysis of the gene identified a c864 + 4A>G mutation'), describing Cases A-G individually.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script assembled the JSON from my hand-entered values and checked every span verbatim. Labels: the paper's own 'Case A'-'Case G'. Table 1 (patients as rows) gives zygosity ('c864 + 4A > G Mutation Status' column), age and troponin values; Case A's variant string is taken from the text ('c864 + 4A>G'), the others from the Table 1 header ('c864 + 4A > G'), both printed without 'c.'. The footnote girl ('The young female generation VI in Fig. 1') is included as 'unnamed person 1' as a relative described in relation to 'her late father' (which brother is not stated in text); no variant row because her genotype appears only in Fig. 1. Group statements used: 'the three affected heterozygous women' (= Cases D, F, G per the text) for LV systolic impairment, atrial fibrillation and onset in the fifth decade, and 'none has complained of exercise-induced myalgia'; 'three brothers and their mother' for elevated troponin I; 'All three brothers' for mild learning difficulties; 'The three sons (A–C) and their severely affected mother (D)' for anti-arrhythmics/ICD. Variant fields for relatives: functional evidence (fibroblast assays on the proband) left not reported for relatives; variant type 'splice' from 'The mutation identified in the LAMP2 gene affects splicing' (the pedigree's single mutation); pathogenicity 'causal mutation' from the pedigree screening sentence. Inheritance: A-C maternal (mother carries), D maternal (maternal grandmother G carries), E maternal (mother F harbours identical mutation); F and G not reported (F's parentage not stated in text). 'Electromyography was normal' and 'EEG ... was normal' recorded as excluded abnormal EMG/EEG; 'no evidence of liver disease' (Case B) recorded as written; the girl's 'Cardiac investigations are currently not abnormal' recorded as written (abnormal cardiac investigations, excluded). Contradictions: (1) Abstract says thyrotoxicosis 'caused the death of a 21 year-old man', but the text has Case A dying at 21 of cardiac failure and VT and Case B (thyrotoxicosis) dying at 23; nothing attributed from the abstract sentence. (2) Case C is 'Now aged twenty four years' in the text but 'Age 21' in Table 1 (text used). (3) Case E is 'this 36 year-old cousin' in the text but 'Age 31' in Table 1 (text used). (4) Mother D 'now in her 50′s' vs Table 1 'Age 57' (table used for numeric age). Case F's treatment sentence ('cardioversion or other treatment was required until the ages of 59 and 36') appears garbled, so F treatment left not reported. n_patients_reported left null: no total stated. study_type 'case report' (single pedigree) is a judgement call.
